public_rationale: The evidence is consistent with continued spending on the scale Zitron described. In particular, a secondary estimate assigns Anthropic $4.1 billion of training expenditure in 2025. But the reviewed OpenAI figures mix periods or broader spending categories, and the competitor figure lacks an architecture breakdown. These records do not meet the stated early-resolution rule across the claim's scope. The uncertainty about data legality is not a prediction that illegality occurred.
limitations: Broad R&D and compute totals are not counted as training-only expenditure.
Secondary estimates lack directly inspected underlying financial records.
A collective industry reading would be easier to satisfy than a separate-company reading.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and its competitors will keep pouring billions into training transformer models on possibly illegally acquired data.

statement.excerpt: And because OpenAI (and the competition) are so deep in the hole with transformer-based models, I believe they will continue to drive billions into them, burning money on training them using data that may or may not have been legally acquired

from_speaker: will continue to drive billions into them
data that may or may not have been legally acquired
our_interpretation: The plain reading is continued multibillion-dollar investment in transformer training by OpenAI and competing developers after publication.
The article's preceding financial discussion relies on press estimates and includes training data acquisition and preparation within training costs; estimate is therefore the accounting basis.
Billions means at least two billion dollars, but the claim does not say per model, per company, or per year. I do not import the screens' annual threshold.
May or may not have been legally acquired makes no definite prediction of illegality.
The proposed sunk-cost motive is not established merely by observing continued spending.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish continued post-publication spending of billions on transformer training by OpenAI and competing developers, with sufficient separation from inference, unrelated research, and infrastructure commitments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive event establishes abandonment of the relevant training investment before the predicted continued multibillion-dollar spending occurs.
